class.name: CbNames
class.brief_description: The names the server's mods declare, for tools: which there are, and what a scene names that nobody declares.
class.description: A look is written against names a server mod declares ([code]combat.health[/code], [code]melee.hit[/code], [code]dash[/code]). The server's build writes them to [code]res://cinderbox_names.cfg[/code]; the editor offers them where a property holds one name and warns, in the scene tree, about one nobody declares. This class is the same check for scripts: publishing a look runs it over every scene of the project. Without the file there is nothing to check against: [method is_known] is false and [method check_scene] finds nothing.

method.name: is_known
method.description: True when the project has a names file.

method.name: check_scene
method.description: What [param root] and the nodes under it name that nobody declares, a line each: the node's path, the property, the name, and the closest name there is.
